title: Mixture-of-Kittens: MoE Megakernel for NVL72s
abstract: arXiv:2609.36070v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI accelerator systems are rapidly consolidating into scale-up architectures, where tens to thousands of GPUs communicate over high-bandwidth, single-hop fabrics. We find that existing Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) training systems, optimized for conventional scale-out networks, transfer poorly to this setting, often running slower than a naive baseline built with PyTorch and NCCL. With industry roadmaps pointing toward even larger scale-up domains, understanding the performance tradeoffs of this hardware regime is increasingly important. We present Mixture-of-Kittens (MoK), an MoE training system designed for Nvidia NVL72. MoK builds on three insights that unlock performance on scale-up domains: (1) choosing push- or pull-based communication per operator, (2) restructuring the computation-communication overlap, and (3) fully eliminating CPU-GPU synchronization. translated_title: Mixture-of-Kittens（小猫混合专家）：面向NVL72的混合专家巨核训练系统
translated_abstract: AI加速器系统正迅速整合为纵向扩展架构，其中数十至数千个GPU通过高带宽、单跳的互连网络进行通信。我们发现，现有针对传统横向扩展网络优化的混合专家模型训练系统难以适应这种新环境，其运行速度往往低于使用PyTorch和NCCL构建的朴素基线。鉴于行业路线图正指向规模更大的纵向扩展域，理解这种硬件体制下的性能权衡变得日益重要。我们提出了Mixture-of-Kittens（MoK），一个专为Nvidia NVL72设计的MoE训练系统。MoK建立在三项能在纵向扩展域上释放性能的关键洞察之上：（1）为每个算子选择基于推送或拉取的通信方式，（2）重构计算与通信的重叠方式，（3）完全消除CPU与GPU之间的同步。MoK将这些洞察提炼为一个单一的确定性训练巨核……
tldr: 本文提出专为Nvidia NVL72纵向扩展架构设计的MoE训练系统Mixture-of-Kittens（MoK），通过为每个算子选择推送或拉取式通信、重构计算-通信重叠以及完全消除CPU-GPU同步三项关键洞察，将其提炼为单一确定性训练巨核，解决了现有面向横向扩展网络的MoE训练系统在新架构上性能不佳甚至不如朴素基线的问题。
en_tdlr: Mixture-of-Kittens (MoK) is an MoE training system designed for Nvidia NVL72 scale-up domains that distills three key insights—per-operator push/pull communication choice, restructured computation-communication overlap, and fully eliminated CPU-GPU synchronization—into a single deterministic training megakernel, outperforming existing MoE systems optimized for conventional scale-out networks.
